accident_report: V1 (car) is in Lane 2, 10 meters ahead of V3 (another car) which is also in Lane 2. V2 (truck) is in Lane 3, approximately parallel to V1 initially. V1 intends to change lanes from Lane 2 to Lane 3 where V2 is traveling. V1 signals and starts to change lanes from Lane 2 to Lane 3. V2 in Lane 3 is traveling at a steady speed and does not notice V1's lane change until it is too late. V1 drifts out of Lane 2 and into Lane 3, but misjudges the distance or speed of V2. V1 sideswipes V2, causing a minor collision where both vehicles suffer some damage. V3 in Lane 2 has to brake suddenly to avoid a potential rear-end collision with V1 if V1 had to abort the lane change and return to Lane 2. The outcome is a sideswipe collision between V1 and V2. V3 narrowly avoids a rear-end collision with V1.
